summary.headline: Astrological Omens of Dangerous Illness
summary.text: Astrological rules for diagnosing dangerous illness from the nativity and decumbiture: physicians’ origins, hebdomadal and enneadic climacterics, lunar applications and squares to the natal and transiting Suns, and afflicted lights. Julian’s further omens concern death from Saturn and Mars, pestilence, war, sailing, fire, deluge, winter, comets, and other configurations signifying common destruction.
